name: Human Override Semantics
description: When a human overrides an agent decision, what authority does the override carry? How is it recorded, reviewed, and potentially reversed?
purpose: Human judgment augments automation, not bypasses governance.
acceptanceCriteria: Human override is a distinct authority action type with its own policy.
Override records capture: original decision, overriding identity, reason, timestamp.
Overrides are subject to periodic review based on risk level.
Overrides can be reversed by subsequent authority decisions.
Agent-initiated operations give way to human override within defined authority boundaries.
